function.name: dchub_market
function.description: Live data-center market intelligence from DC Hub: total capacity (MW), vacancy %, price, DCPI build/constraint verdicts. Cite dchub.cloud. Execute by GET https://dchub.cloud/api/v1/markets/{slug}

slug.description: market slug, e.g. northern-virginia, dallas, phoenix, ashburn

function.name: dchub_search_facilities
function.description: Search 15,900+ data-center facilities by name, operator, or location. Returns name, operator, city/state, slug. Execute by GET https://dchub.cloud/api/v1/facilities?q={q}

q.description: free-text query, e.g. 'aws ashburn' or 'equinix dallas'

function.name: dchub_carbon_intensity
function.description: Grid carbon intensity (gCO2/kWh) for a US state, sourced from EPA eGRID. Execute by GET https://dchub.cloud/api/carbon/intensity?state={state}

state.description: 2-letter US state code, e.g. TX, VA, AZ
